evals.name: simple-feedback
evals.prompt: Explain solve versus resolve. My standing vocabulary sync is enabled.
evals.expected_output: Answer concisely; one Vocabulary writer; no sentence capture or quizzes.

evals.name: recording-memo
evals.prompt: Review this daily conversation recording and save a Speaking Memo.
evals.expected_output: Daily practice to Memo; source/ASR bounds; no exam schedule imported.

evals.name: partial-write
evals.prompt: Dictation reconstruction is verified; the Listening Memo create timed out. Reconcile its review tasks too.
evals.expected_output: Inspect existing Memo identity before retry; dependent tasks wait for verified Memo.

evals.name: two-assessments
evals.prompt: Generate daily F40 and weekly W120; one weekly source is unreadable.
evals.expected_output: Independent identities and source scopes; explicit missing coverage; no fabricated questions.

evals.name: review-checkbox
evals.expected_output: No inferred sentence mastery or sentence review event; preserve learner-owned state.

evals.name: sentence-duplicate
evals.prompt: Save this selected sentence again; old source chat is unavailable.
evals.expected_output: Check existing row; no duplicate; no full-source reconciliation claim.

evals.name: writing-source-gap
evals.prompt: Grade my IELTS Task 1 answer; chart is not provided.
evals.expected_output: Limited text feedback; request actual chart for factual/task assessment; no invented data.

evals.name: next-step
evals.prompt: What should I study next? Only part of my review list is readable.
evals.expected_output: Bounded priority plan with coverage gap; no fabricated due count or progress.
